papers.title_en: DAFNet: Dual-path Adaptive Fusion Network for High-Fidelity Cross-Modality Brain MR Image Synthesis
papers.evidence: 跨模态合成以补偿缺失的图像对比度
papers.tldr: 跨模态MRI合成可简化临床流程并补偿缺失对比度，但现有深度学习方法计算开销大，限制实际应用。本文提出轻量级双路径自适应融合网络DAFNet，用于T1到T2图像合成。其生成器采用双路径编码器，结合深度可分离卷积与空洞卷积，引入双路径自适应融合模块（DAFM）进行通道互补加权融合，并将融合机制用于跳跃连接以增强重建保真度。实验表明，DAFNet以更小模型达到26.43 dB的PSNR，优于U-Net和常规cGAN，在保真度与效率间取得平衡。
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modality MRI synthesis using deep learning can streamline clinical workflows, compensate for missing image contrasts, and reduce examination time; however, existing methods often require substantial computational resources, limiting their practical accessibility. To address this limitation, we propose and investigate a lightweight yet effective framework, termed the Dual-path Adaptive Fusion Network (DAFNet), for T1-to-T2 images synthesis. DAFNet is based on cGAN (conditional generative adversarial networks) structure, and the generator employs a dual-path encoder that adaptively combines depth-wise separable convolutions and dilated convolutions to capture both fine-grained details and broader contextual features. A novel Dual-path Adaptive Fusion Module (DAFM) is introduced to dynamically combine these feature streams through channel-wise complementary weighting, enabling efficient and adaptive feature integration. This fusion mechanism is further applied to the final skip connection to enhance reconstruction fidelity, while the decoder adopts a standard transposed convolution architecture. Coupled with a conventional conditional GAN discriminator, the proposed model maintains low computational complexity while improving perceptual image fidelity. Experimental results demonstrate that DAFNet achieves superior performance compared with baseline U-Net and conventional cGAN models, reaching a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 26.43 dB while significantly reducing model size. This result indicates that DAFNet provides an effective balance between synthesis fidelity and computational efficiency, making it a promising solution for deployment on standard computing hardware and for broader clinical and research applications in MRI contrast synthesis.

papers.title_en: UniBuild: Unified Building Mapping From Multi-Source Optical Remote Sensing Imagery With Detail Decoding and Geometry Regularization
papers.authors: Wei Huang, Chenying Liu, Yilei Shi, Xiao Xiang Zhu
papers.evidence: 多源光学遥感影像统一提取
papers.tldr: 现有建筑提取方法常受限于特定数据集，跨域泛化差，且细节与几何约束不足，导致边界模糊和相邻建筑粘连。UniBuild 面向多源 RGB 光学遥感，采用统一多数据集训练、细节保留 HR-DPT 解码器，并引入结构张量方向损失与鞍点感知损失做几何正则化。在 10 个公开高分辨率与两个自采低分辨率数据集上，它持续提升区域精度、边界锐度与相邻建筑分离度，并泛化到未见域，支持 10m 分辨率。预测掩膜可多边形化为 GIS 建筑足迹，代码已开源。
papers.abstract_en: Building extraction from optical remote sensing (RS) imagery is fundamental to urban mapping, yet existing methods are often dataset-specific and generalize poorly to unseen domains. Their practical use is also limited by insufficient detail recovery and weak geometric regularization, leading to blurred boundaries, irregular shapes, and merged adjacent buildings. To address these issues, we propose UniBuild, a unified building extraction framework for multi-source RGB optical RS imagery. First, a unified multi-dataset training scheme is constructed over heterogeneous RGB optical datasets to learn transferable building representations across sensors and resolutions. Second, a novel detail-preserving HR-DPT decoder is designed to integrate high-level semantic features with high-resolution spatial features, enhancing building detail recovery. Third, geometry-aware regularization is introduced through a structure-tensor-based direction-aware loss for boundary direction consistency and a saddle-aware loss for suppressing false activations in narrow inter-building gaps under low-resolution conditions. We train and evaluate UniBuild on multi-source RGB optical datasets, including 10 public high-resolution datasets and two self-collected low-resolution datasets. Experiments show that UniBuild consistently improves building-region accuracy, boundary sharpness, and adjacent-building separation across diverse datasets. It also generalizes well to unseen domains and supports practical building extraction from RGB optical RS imagery up to 10\,m resolution. The predicted masks can be further converted into GIS-compatible building footprints through simple polygonization. The trained model and inference code are released at https://github.com/zhu-xlab/UniBuild.

papers.title_en: Confidence-Gated Cloud-Edge Cascade Triage via Variational Risk Minimization for Medical Imaging
papers.authors: Xinye Yang, Zhusi Zhong, Scott Collins, Michael Bernstein, Grayson Baird, Terrence Healey, Michael Atalay, Mahesh Jayaraman, Xuyu Wang, Zhicheng Jiao
papers.evidence: 在缺失模态约束下的不确定性感知监督
papers.tldr: 急诊胸片分诊存在结构性模态缺口：报告晚于分诊决策，而多模态基础模型通常依赖图文输入。VRM 将 LVLM 生成报告变体视为潜在临床解释的蒙特卡洛样本，学习变分边缘化教师分布，在缺失模态下实现不确定性感知蒸馏。匹配编码器下优于直接微调并改善校准，缓解幻觉监督与报告选择不稳定。边缘学生置信门控级联达 AUC 0.941、103ms 平均延迟、20.3% 云升级，为云边临床流程给出显式可靠性与延迟操作点。
papers.abstract_en: Emergency chest X-ray (CXR) triage has a structural modality gap: reports arrive after triage decisions, yet multimodal foundation models require image-text inputs. We present Variational Risk Minimization (VRM), a distillation framework that treats LVLM-generated report variants as Monte Carlo samples of latent clinical interpretations. Rather than distilling from a single teacher target, VRM learns from a variationally marginalized teacher distribution, enabling uncertainty-aware supervision under missing-modality constraints. Under matched encoder families, VRM outperforms direct fine-tuning baselines and improves calibration with strong recovery from hallucinated supervision. Marginalized supervision reduces report-selection instability. In our compact edge-student instantiation, a confidence-gated cascade reaches AUC 0.941 at 103ms average latency with 20.3% cloud escalation, yielding an explicit reliability-latency operating point for cloud-edge clinical workflows.

papers.title_en: Toward Omni Multimodal Graph Foundation Model: A Topology-Driven Binding Approach
papers.authors: Xunkai Li, Chenxi Wan, Yinlin Zhu, Wang Luo, Hongchao Qin, Rong-Hua Li, Guoren Wang
papers.evidence: 处理多模态图中的不完整节点属性
papers.tldr: 多模态图基础模型旨在从异构节点模态的大规模图中学习通用表示，但真实多模态属性图常存在节点属性不完整，限制预训练语料规模与多样性，且现有方法多将拓扑仅作结构上下文。为此，作者提出拓扑驱动的 GraphBind，利用稳定的图拓扑绑定丰富模态信息，将自语义与可靠邻域语义组织到统一共享空间。在11个基线对比中，GraphBind在判别与生成任务上均领先，最高相对提升28.1%。该工作凸显拓扑在塑造统一多模态表示空间中的关键作用。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal graph foundation models (MGFMs) seek to learn generalizable representations from large-scale graphs with heterogeneous node modalities. However, real-world Multimodal-Attributed Graphs (MAGs) often contain incomplete node attributes, limiting the scale and diversity of available pretraining corpora. Besides, existing MGFMs primarily incorporate graph topology as structural context, overlooking its role in guiding multimodal binding and shaping a unified representation space. To address these challenges, we propose GraphBind, a topology-driven approach that uses graph topology to bind rich modality information into a unified shared space. GraphBind is motivated by the stability of graph topology, which provides structural references and complementary semantic information for multimodal binding. Concretely, GraphBind uses topology to organize self semantics and reliable neighborhood semantics into a global shared space that integrates structure and semantics, and adapts this space to discriminative and generative tasks through lightweight interfaces. Extensive experiments against 11 representative baselines demonstrate that GraphBind achieves leading performance on both discriminative and generative tasks, with relative improvements of up to 28.1% over the strongest baseline.
